rendered:
1. Aging of the NiTi wire (pretreatment, to activate its superelastic/shape-memory property): the wires were aged at 600 °C for 1 h[1] under vacuum in a quartz CVD tube furnace, then mechanically polished to remove the native oxide.
2. Atomic layer deposition of the vanadium oxide coating: the deposition ran at a reaction temperature of 200 °C[2] maintained throughout the process. No separate time is given for this step; it ran through repeated ALD cycles.
3. Post-deposition annealing of the oxide film: the deposited films were annealed at 450 °C[3] for 30 min[4] in a quartz CVD tube furnace open to air, to crystallize the coating as V2O5.
